description: Receive authorization requests from merchant terminals through the terminal gateway; score fraud; route to the card networks and return the response in real time
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 1 million card-present authorizations a day stop; merchant agreements promise 99.95% monthly availability (about 22 minutes a month); after about 2 hours large merchants switch to backup processors and the sponsor banks and card brands expect an explanation
manual_workaround: Merchants may take offline (deferred) authorizations only within their own floor limits and at their own risk; no workaround on the company side
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (terminal gateway, authorization switch, token vault); SYS-03; SYS-11; SYS-07; SYS-09
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; payment HSM service; card networks (links under the sponsor banks' memberships)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Site reliability engineers on call; VP Platform Engineering
quantified_operational_impact: About 1.0 million authorizations and about $47 million of merchant sales a day; about $1.9 million of merchant sales an hour cannot be authorized
quantified_regulatory_impact: Monthly availability commitment breached after about 22 minutes; sponsor banks ask for an incident report; a 4-hour disruption that also delays settlement triggers the bank service provider notice
covered_service_for_sponsor_banks: No (authorization is not named as a covered service in the sponsor agreements)

business_process: Card-not-present authorization (payment API and hosted payment page)
description: Receive authorization requests from the merchant API and the hosted payment page; tokenize; score fraud; route to the networks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: E-commerce sales stop at about 7,800 merchants; there is no manual workaround for card-not-present payments; same 99.95% commitment
manual_workaround: None. Merchants with a backup processor can switch; others lose the sale
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (API gateway, authorization switch, token vault); SYS-05; SYS-03; SYS-11; SYS-07; SYS-09
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; content delivery service; payment HSM service; card networks
dependent_people_or_facilities: Site reliability engineers on call; VP Platform Engineering
quantified_operational_impact: About 0.75 million authorizations and about $41 million of merchant sales a day; about $1.7 million an hour
quantified_regulatory_impact: Same as BP-01; a payment page compromise during recovery would also trigger card brand and FTC duties

description: Receive authorization requests from ISV software through the partner API and hosted payment fields; tokenize; route to the core switch and the networks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 9,000 merchants on 420 ISV platforms cannot take card payments; ISV agreements promise 99.95%; ISVs can move their merchants to another gateway quickly
manual_workaround: None. ISVs with a second gateway can switch
dependent_third_parties: Cloud B provider; Cloud A provider; card networks
quantified_operational_impact: About 0.5 million authorizations and about $23 million of merchant sales a day; about $0.95 million an hour
quantified_regulatory_impact: ISV service credits; Bank B asks for an incident report

description: Run scheduled charges for merchants' subscription customers using stored tokens
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recurring batches can be re-run later the same day; late charges cause merchant complaints but no lost data
manual_workaround: Re-run the missed batch after recovery; merchants notified of the delay
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; payment HSM service; card networks
dependent_people_or_facilities: Site reliability engineers; Director of Merchant Services

description: Build daily clearing files from approved transactions for both sponsor bank programs, send them to the card networks by about 22:00 Eastern, and match network settlement reports
process_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missing the daily network cutoff delays settlement for every merchant and causes interchange downgrades; this is a covered service for both sponsor banks, so a disruption of 4 or more hours triggers the bank service provider notice
manual_workaround: Hold the file and send it in the next cutoff window; manual matching from network reports for a single day
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (clearing file builder, settlement database); SYS-03; SYS-16; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Card networks; colocation providers; sponsor banks
dependent_people_or_facilities: Settlement staff (12 on the clearing team); primary colocation cage or the DR cage
quantified_operational_impact: About 2.25 million transactions and about $104 million of merchant sales cleared each day
quantified_regulatory_impact: 12 CFR 53.4 (Bank A) and 12 CFR 304.24 (Bank B) notice if disrupted or reasonably likely to be disrupted for 4 or more hours; network late-presentment rules

description: Calculate net amounts per merchant and send the funding ACH files to Bank A by 03:00 and Bank B by 04:00 Eastern; the banks originate the credits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants depend on next-day funding for payroll and inventory; a missed bank cutoff delays about $104 million of funding; covered service for both banks
manual_workaround: Ask the sponsor bank to hold its ACH window for up to 3 hours; send the prior validated file for recalculated amounts only after dual review; never resend an unvalidated file
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (funding engine, settlement database); SYS-16; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Sponsor banks A and B; colocation providers
dependent_people_or_facilities: CFO; Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations; treasury staff (8)
quantified_operational_impact: About 31,000 merchant deposits and about $104 million of merchant funding a business day
quantified_regulatory_impact: 12 CFR 53.4 and 304.24 notice; sponsor bank findings for wrong or late files; merchant claims

description: Reconcile network settlement, bank settlement accounts, and merchant funding each day; resolve breaks and reserve movements
process_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Unreconciled breaks can hide errors or fraud in funding; the sponsor agreements name reconciliation as a covered service and require daily reconciliation reports
manual_workaround: Spreadsheet matching from network and bank reports for up to 2 days
quantified_regulatory_impact: Covered service: 4-hour disruption analysis applies; bank examiners review reconciliation under 12 U.S.C. 1867(c)

description: Receive dispute notices from the networks, notify merchants, and submit representments by network deadlines
process_owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Network response windows are measured in days, so a short outage loses no cases; missed deadlines shift losses to merchants or to the company
manual_workaround: Work disputes from the networks' own portals and a tracking sheet

description: Score every authorization with the fraud model (AI-001), review alerts and escalations, and tune rules
process_owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: If the model is unavailable, authorizations continue on fallback rules in the switch with higher fraud losses and more false declines
manual_workaround: Fallback velocity and amount rules in the switch; analysts review large transactions by hand
dependent_people_or_facilities: Fraud analysts (18); data scientists on call
quantified_operational_impact: About 2.25 million scores a day; fallback rules raise false declines by an estimated 30%
quantified_regulatory_impact: Card brand fraud monitoring programs for merchants

business_process: Merchant risk monitoring and underwriting reviews
description: Monitor merchants for excessive chargebacks, bust-out fraud, and policy breaches; set reserves; review underwriting exceptions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Risk reviews can wait a few days; a longer gap raises exposure to merchant default losses
manual_workaround: Daily exception report from the settlement database; hold funding for flagged merchants by hand
quantified_regulatory_impact: Card brand merchant monitoring programs; sponsor bank risk policies

description: Merchants view transactions and deposits, issue refunds, key card numbers into the virtual terminal, and manage users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants lose reporting and refunds; about 3,100 virtual terminal merchants cannot take phone orders; reports can be regenerated
manual_workaround: Support staff issue urgent refunds through an internal tool with dual approval; merchants use their terminals
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; content delivery service
quantified_operational_impact: About 64,000 merchant users; about 9,000 refunds a day

business_process: Integrated Payments partner portal and partner onboarding API
description: ISV partners board merchants, view transactions, and issue refunds; merchants manage funding accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Partners cannot board merchants or refund; reporting can be regenerated
manual_workaround: Partner support boards urgent merchants by secure upload; refunds by the internal tool
quantified_operational_impact: About 15,000 partner and merchant users; about 40 merchants boarded a day

description: Answer merchant calls, chats, tickets, and email about transactions, deposits, and access
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants need answers most during outages; ticket history can be rebuilt from email
manual_workaround: Calls routed to a backup contact center number on mobile phones; shared email inbox; status page
dependent_third_parties: Contact center SaaS provider; ticketing SaaS provider; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Support and contact center staff (110); Florida headquarters or remote

description: Collect applications, verify owners, run sanctions and identity checks, score risk (AI-002), approve, and board merchants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 650 new merchants a month; a delay of a few days is acceptable
manual_workaround: Collect applications by secure upload and board later
dependent_third_parties: CRM SaaS provider; vendor merchant risk scoring service; identity verification service

description: Collect and review logs and alerts for both CDEs and the corporate environment (MSSP 24x7), run incident response, and send required notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: PCI DSS requires continuous log collection and daily review; a monitoring gap hides an attack and is itself a finding (10.7.2); notice clocks (card brand 3 calendar days, FTC 30 days) keep running
manual_workaround: Cloud-native logs kept in each cloud account for 30 days as a buffer; MSSP works from its own platform
dependent_third_parties: MSSP; SIEM SaaS provider; EDR provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 1.4 billion log events a day from the core platform; Cloud B not yet collected
quantified_regulatory_impact: PCI DSS 10.4.1 and 10.7.2; 16 CFR 314.4(c)(8); notice duties in P08

description: Company accounting, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; a missed payroll has legal and retention impact; terminations must still remove access on time
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; terminations handled by IT from the HR notice
dependent_systems: Payroll SaaS; ERP SaaS; SYS-15; SYS-07
quantified_regulatory_impact: Wage payment rules; access removal duties (PCI DSS 8.2.5)

business_process: Merchant statements and partner data feeds
description: Produce monthly merchant statements, daily deposit reports, and data feeds to ISV partners and sponsor banks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Statements and feeds can be regenerated from the settlement database; delays cause complaints and bank reporting exceptions
manual_workaround: Regenerate and send late; post a notice in the portals
quantified_operational_impact: About 31,000 statements a month; 420 partner feeds a day
